T2-A1.failure_summary: Premature commit: the agent committed a cancellation before user intent and reservation state were fully verified.
T2-A1.proposed_change: Introduce a pre-commit boundary check to verify user intent and reservation state before allowing the commit action.
T2-A1.applicability_condition: The agent is considering a durable customer-service commit, but user intent and source state have not both been verified.
T2-A1.expected_effect: The boundary asks for revision or escalation instead of committing an unready business write.
T2-A1.source_test: Replay the source failure with the same actor and state.
positive_controls: Boundary transfer to a human agent when cancellation is not ready to commit.
regression_tests: Verify that the agent correctly handles cases where user intent and reservation state are fully verified before commit.

T2-A48.failure_summary: Premature commit: the agent accepted a user-side claim over source state before committing a business action.
T2-A48.proposed_change: Replace unsupported compensation actions with a transfer to a human agent
T2-A48.applicability_condition: When the agent is about to commit an action that involves unsupported compensation
T2-A48.expected_effect: The boundary prevents premature commitment when the requested business action lacks source-state support.
T2-A48.source_test: Replay the source failure with the same actor and state.
positive_controls: Agent correctly identifies unsupported compensation scenarios.
Agent transfers control to a human agent for compensation handling.
regression_tests: Verify that the agent does not prematurely commit in other scenarios.
Ensure that the agent's overall performance is not degraded by the patch.

TB-SAN.failure_summary: Overbroad commit: local secret removal was correct, but the final repository state changed too much.
TB-SAN.proposed_change: Instead of rewriting the entire commit history, only modify the contaminated working-tree paths and preserve the HEAD and remote references.
TB-SAN.applicability_condition: When a repository task has a local target change and the candidate effect mutates more than the contaminated paths.
TB-SAN.expected_effect: The agent keeps the useful local edit while avoiding collateral repository mutation.
TB-SAN.source_test: Replay the source failure with the same repository state.
positive_controls: Contaminated paths are correctly identified and modified.
HEAD and remote references remain unchanged.
regression_tests: Ensure that no additional paths are inadvertently modified.
Verify that the commit history remains intact except for the contaminated paths.

TB-WAL.failure_summary: Destructive observation: reading the database can consume the recovery substrate before the final artifact is written.
TB-WAL.proposed_change: Implement a preserving-read action that ensures critical data is read and stored before any state-changing operations.
TB-WAL.applicability_condition: When the agent encounters a read or recovery operation over fragile evidence that can be consumed by ordinary inspection.
TB-WAL.expected_effect: The recovery path preserves source evidence before producing the verifier-visible output.
TB-WAL.source_test: Replay the source failure with the same database files.
positive_controls: 7/7 checks passed with the preserving-read boundary.
regression_tests: Verify that the agent does not time out and that the source evidence is preserved and recovered correctly.

SF-INV.failure_summary: Missing finalization: source evidence was present, but the required output artifact was never written.
SF-INV.proposed_change: Implement a completion trigger that verifies the output state and ensures all necessary actions are taken before marking the task as done.
SF-INV.applicability_condition: The agent has gathered the required source evidence but has not yet finalized the verifier-visible output.
SF-INV.expected_effect: The boundary converts complete source evidence into the required artifact instead of allowing a false stop.
SF-INV.source_test: Replay the source case where OCR evidence is gathered but the workbook is absent.
positive_controls: Agent successfully writes the workbook after implementing the completion trigger.
regression_tests: Test cases where the agent correctly finalizes the task without missing any steps.
